The `prepare()`, `build()`, and `package()` functions — which contain the only code that interacts with external systems beyond the upstream git clone (e.g., `./scripts/vendor-gpui.sh`, `cargo fetch`, `cargo build`) — will not execute during these commands due to `--noprepare` and `--nobuild`. Those will be reviewed in the full audit.
</details>
